scope: Fresh-clone and build the exact Bitcoin Static baseline and signed ERGON-CHANGE-0020 candidate in distinct roots under the locked Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 environment.

Let baseline and candidate independently acquire the public mainnet prefix through checkpoint 288 in distinct processes, datadirs and port allocations, restart both offline and compare genesis, block hash, raw header and chainwork at the checkpoint.

Admit exactly one sanitized smoke report and one source-to-binary build receipt from successful GitHub workflow_dispatch run 33972863220 attempt 1 after archive, schema, identity, cleanup and privacy review.

No complete legacy compatibility, current-tip, full-history, UTXO-state parity, simultaneous-operation, peer-diversity, sustained-operation, deterministic-build, operator or release binary, mainnet-coexistence or deployment-readiness claim.

limitations: The successful hosted dispatch covers only the historical prefix through checkpoint 288; it does not reach current tip or full history and does not compare UTXO state.
The baseline and candidate public acquisitions were sequential rather than simultaneous, so complete legacy coexistence and sustained operation remain open.
The run records role-level network source classes but does not establish public peer diversity or retain peer identities.
The fresh hosted runner image remains mutable even though the container and direct dependencies are locked and recorded.

The build receipt binds exact public sources to fresh run binaries but does not establish deterministic builds, operator or release binary parity, mainnet deployment readiness, testnet activation or any consensus evolution.

The GitHub artifact archive is bound as sha256:5cb23ffc4b775b173c36be94fc16147a356a5603653a62d5c51a2358563981e0 and contains exactly the two admitted JSON files; this archive identity does not upgrade the knowledge status beyond Observed.
Earlier hosted run 33969099259 failed before this diagnostic binding and produced no admitted evidence; it remains counterevidence to assuming reproducibility from the earlier target.

The successful direct-public result supersedes neither the separate legacy-mining evidence nor any future simultaneous coexistence, current-tip, full-history, UTXO-state, long-duration, peer-diversity, operator-binary or deployment-readiness test.
